title: Increasing Tangential Gain
statement: Increasing the tangential gain will improve the robot's ability to navigate around obstacles by enhancing its turning agility.
mechanism: The tangential gain affects how quickly the robot can adjust its direction to avoid obstacles.
contradicting_evidence: Experiment plan_63367a43: Observed delta=+0.000. Verdict: inconclusive (Time difference (+0.31s) is within experimental noise margin.). (Did not produce statistically distinguishable change)
